purpose: Small fixed comparison of stable source scope, scoped speaker/mention entity index, pre-existing query inputs, and mild explicit-date reranking
scope_rule: The caller supplies the LoCoMo sample_id as a knowledge-space ID; source provenance.sample_id must match. The benchmark case.family supplies this ID only for this simulation, never an answer or reference ID.
entity_rule: Within that sample_id, person_id = sample_id + ':' + casefold(query-specified name). A source qualifies if the name exactly matches a structured speaker role OR appears as a whole word in its original text. Multiple target people use OR. Speaker and mention flags are separately recorded.
query_rule: Raw question or the BM25 input already published in smm-query-input-001/authored-inputs.tsv; no new query writing, no answer terms or reference IDs used by ranking.
time_rule: For explicit English month+year queries only, parse an exact day if present, or days 1-10 when 'beginning' appears. Multiply BM25 score by 1.25 when source received_at UTC date lies in that interval; no hard exclusion. For other queries, score is unchanged. This is a fixed diagnostic heuristic, not a general temporal parser.
metric: Top5/Top10 any and all official reference sources, per-reference positions, source retention, candidate counts and provenance; answer sufficiency reviewed separately
limitations: Purposively chosen 12 known benchmark cases, not blind; entity names are supplied by the evaluator, without extraction/disambiguation; sample_id is caller-known scope, not discovered by search; exact date heuristic tests only explicit dates; official citations can be incomplete or redundant.
